ARQAAM WEALTH

Services / Arqaam Wealth

Providing independent global wealth management with regional expertise, including investment advisory, portfolio construction, custodian risk diversification, consolidated reporting, and administrative account support

Arqaam Wealth

Arqaam Wealth offers independent global wealth management with regional identity and products. We invest in developing a complete view of our high net worth and family office clients, their wealth, circumstances, and ambitions; and provide a tailored service to manage their wealth, working closely with their banks and custodians, to address their future needs and aspirations.

Arqaam Wealth services include:

Wealth Management, on a discretionary and non-discretionary basis

Portfolio Construction

Investment Advisory

Outsourced CIO Capabilities

Custodian risk diversification

Consolidated Reporting

Administrative Support

Arqaam Wealth products include the full range of Arqaam products and services, including Equities, Fixed Income, Funds and Alternatives as well as other products and services.

Arqaam Wealth focuses on the following:

Protect and grow your hard-earned generated wealth

Dealing with diverse financial institutions with a united vision

Structure your wealth legally and tax efficiently

Diversify and reduce risks to your portfolio

Provide liquidity

Maintain confidentiality

Avoid family conflict

Advise on philanthropic wishes
